 Versus

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Raj Kumar Singh, learned
counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned A.G.A.
along with Mr. Manoj Bhatt, learned
Brief Holder for the State.
3. Ms. Swaleha Hussain, learned
counsel for the complainant.
4. By means of the present
application, the applicant seeks
anticipatory bail in connection with the
F.I.R./Case Crime No.153 of 2025,
registered at Police Station-Sahaspur,
District Dehradun under Sections 105
and 115(2) of the B.N.S.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants
would submit that according to the First
Information Report dated 11.07.2025,
the applicant no.1 is the father-in-law of
the informant Dhanveer; that, the
applicant no.2 is the wife and applicant
nos. 3, 4 and applicant no.5 are the
daughters of the applicant no.1. It is
alleged that the applicants beat the
mother of the informant on 08.06.2025,
in which, she received injuries and the
informant's mother suffered pain in her
head and chest on 16.06.2025; that, she

UKHC010121962025
2026:UHC:8823
was being taken to the hospital but she
died on the way.
6. Learned counsel for the applicants
would further submit that the applicants
have falsely been implicated in the
present matter; that, applicants did not
commit the alleged offence; that, there is
no connection between the informant's
mother's death and the alleged incident
of 08.06.2025; that, the applicants are
permanent residents of District
Dehradun.
7. Learned State counsel would
submit that the investigation has been
completed and the charge-sheet has
already been submitted before the
competent court.
8. Per contra, learned counsel for the
applicants would submit that the
Coordinate Bench of this Court, vide
order dated 13.08.2025, had granted
interim protection from arrest to the
applicants; that, pursuant thereto, the
applicants have remained available to
the Investigating Officer and have
extended full cooperation during the
course of investigation. It is further
submitted that the investigation having
culminated in filing of the charge-sheet,
no further custodial interrogation of the
applicants are warranted. Learned
counsel, therefore, prays that the interim
anticipatory bail granted to the
applicants on 13.08.2025 be made
absolute.
9. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties and upon perusal of the
material available on record, this Court
finds that the applicants have remained
under the protection of this Court
pursuant to the interim order dated
13.08.2025. There is nothing on record

UKHC010121962025
2026:UHC:8823
to indicate that, during the subsistence
of the said protection, the applicants
have misused the liberty granted to them
or have failed to cooperate with the
investigation. On the contrary, the
investigation has already been concluded
and the charge-sheet has been
submitted before the competent court.
9. Once the investigation has
culminated in the filing of the charge-sheet, the matter has substantially
progressed beyond the stage of
investigation. No material has been
brought on record by the prosecution to
demonstrate that the custodial
interrogations of the applicants are
presently required for any further
purpose. It is also relevant that the
applicants have remained available to
the Investigating Officer during the
period of interim protection and have
subjected themselves to the process of
investigation.
10. This Court is also conscious of the
fact that the interim protection has
continued for a considerable period and
no allegation of misuse of such
protection or non-cooperation on the
part of the applicants have been brought
to the notice of the Court. In these
circumstances, and particularly when
the investigation already stands
concluded and the charge-sheet has
been filed, this Court finds no compelling
reason to disturb the protection from
arrest already extended to the
applicants.
11. Accordingly, having regard to the
facts and circumstances of the case, the
nature of the allegations, the conduct of
the applicants during the period of
interim protection, the completion of

UKHC010121962025
2026:UHC:8823
investigation and submission of the
charge-sheet, this Court is of the
considered view that the interim
protection granted to the applicants vide
order dated 13.08.2025 deserves to be
confirmed.
13. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail
application is allowed. The interim
anticipatory bail granted to the
applicants vide order dated 13.08.2025
is hereby made absolute. In the event of
arrest, the applicants shall be released
on anticipatory bail on the same terms
and conditions as contained in the order
dated 13.08.2025. The applicants shall
continue to abide by the said terms and
conditions and shall also remain subject
to any further condition which may be
imposed by the trial court in accordance
with law.
14. It is made clear that the
observations made in this order are
confined to the consideration of the
present anticipatory bail application and
shall not be construed as an expression
of opinion on the merits of the case. The
trial court shall consider the case
independently and decide the same
strictly on the basis of the evidence
brought on record and in accordance
with law.
15. Pending application(s), if any, also
stand disposed of.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
